AGE returns empty rows for CREATE ... WITH ... MATCH over created nodes; maps to submitted AGE same-query create/MATCH visibility family.
Memgraph later UNION ALL MATCH does not see Charlie created in earlier branch; Neo4j returns the extra Charlie row. Maps to submitted node visibility union family.
Same broad family as previous: second UNION ALL branch does not see nodes created/merged by first branch. Not counted as separate family unless splitting CREATE vs MERGE variants.
List contains Item without age/city; Neo4j filters nonmatching/null predicate element and returns Charlie, Memgraph returns empty. Maps to submitted list-comprehension null predicate family.
CALL { WITH p MATCH ... } returns Alice/Bob on Neo4j but empty on Memgraph. Adjacent to submitted CALL outer-variable/subquery scope families.
After WHERE false, Neo4j returns one aggregate row cnt=0; FalkorDB returns zero rows in 3/3 reruns. Maps to submitted aggregation-after-with-where-false family.
CALL subquery containing MERGE preserves only Alice on FalkorDB; clean Neo4j runs return Alice/Bob/Charlie. Maps to submitted CALL-subquery MERGE/drop-rows family.

Ignoring one artificial concurrent-transaction failure and one dirty Neo4j cleanup run, clean runs show Memgraph assigns UNION subquery outputs to different outer p rows than Neo4j. Maps to submitted CALL UNION outer-scope distribution family.

Clean Neo4j runs return Bob/Alice; Memgraph stably includes unrelated David. Trigger is ANY over correlated pattern comprehension; adjacent to submitted inline/pattern-comprehension correlation-loss family.

FalkorDB returns only first-branch rows after UNWIND CREATE; clean Neo4j runs include later UNION ALL branch rows that read the created Person nodes. Maps to submitted FalkorDB later-union-branch visibility family.
FalkorDB stably misses Alice->Diana reachable by KNOWS*1..2; Neo4j returns the row. Maps to FalkorDB variable-length path undercount/self-loop/path family.

Memgraph returns five e bindings including Eve, although e was bound by an earlier label-only MERGE before the later MERGE of Eve. Neo4j returns four pre-Eve bindings. Maps to submitted label-only MERGE binding expansion family.

Memgraph rejects a legal rematch of an in-scope relationship variable with Redeclaring variable: r in 3/3 runs; Neo4j accepts the query. Maps to submitted relationship-variable reuse wrong-error family.

confirmed.decision: Memgraph rejects ORDER BY over a projected scalar property expression after a legal write/read query with "Only nodes, edges, maps, temporal types and graphs have properties"; Neo4j accepts 3/3. Maps to submitted projected-property ORDER BY wrong-error family.
FalkorDB fails a legal OPTIONAL MATCH/WITH carried variable rematch with filtered alias p in 3/3 runs; Neo4j accepts 3/3. Maps to submitted carried-variable filtered-alias family.

FalkorDB creates a KNOWS relationship and then fails to match it later in the same query, returning empty rows in 3/3 runs; Neo4j returns the created relationship row in 3/3 runs. Maps to submitted created-relationship visibility family.

confirmed.manual_decision: A tiny UNION ALL query with per-branch ORDER BY/LIMIT times out on Memgraph in 3/3 runs; Neo4j accepts 3/3 and returns Alice/Bob. Maps to submitted Memgraph UNION/LIMIT hang family.

FalkorDB reports filtered alias for a legal EXISTS(pattern) query even though the following LIMIT 0 should yield an empty aggregate result; Neo4j returns cnt=0 in 3/3 runs. Maps to submitted pattern-exists filtered-alias family.

FalkorDB drops rows when all(...) is applied after carrying a node through WITH; Neo4j and Memgraph return the matching Alice/Bob rows in 3/3 reruns. Maps to the submitted all-list-predicate-after-WITH family.

AGE drops rows produced by UNWIND [null] before WHERE x IS NULL / aggregation; Neo4j returns one aggregate row count=3 in 3/3 reruns. Adjacent to submitted AGE UNWIND-null/null-aggregate handling families.

Memgraph returns zero rows for an aggregate-plus-scalar expression over empty input, while Neo4j returns a single aggregate row with value 3 in 3/3 reruns. Maps to submitted Memgraph aggregate-plus-scalar empty-input family.

AGE keeps null friendName rows after UNWIND/WHERE friendName IS NOT NULL in 3/3 reruns, while Neo4j returns only Alice/Bob and Diana/Eve. Adjacent to submitted AGE list/null filtering and null-element handling families.

FalkorDB fails 3/3 with Unable to resolve filtered alias for a pattern comprehension in WHERE; Neo4j 2026.03.1 control passes 3/3. Counts as the submitted FalkorDB pattern-comprehension filtered-alias family.

Memgraph passes 3/3 but returns the unnamed map projection column as the full expression text; Neo4j control returns the variable-derived column name. Counts as the submitted unnamed map projection schema family.

Memgraph passes 3/3 but outer RETURN * only exposes nextPath and drops the CALL/UNION subquery result column; Neo4j control exposes nextPath and result. Counts as the submitted CALL UNION RETURN * column-loss family.

Memgraph passes 3/3 but returns only the write-branch row after creating a relationship in the first UNION ALL branch; Neo4j control returns both write and later read rows 3/3. This is the submitted relationship analogue of UNION write-visibility.

FalkorDB passes 3/3 but filters all rows for WHERE ANY(v IN c ...) where c is introduced by WITH; Neo4j control returns five rows 3/3. Counts as the submitted ANY over WITH-bound list variable family.
